highlights: CORE grows through nine stages, from SEED to COSMOS.
AMPLIFY enhances star score and CORE growth; OVER DRIVE pulls stars inward and pauses the countdown.
Completed constellations can be summoned in acquisition order, once per constellation per play.
Legacy C4 challenge and Ghost URLs retain their rules; C4 and C5 bests remain separate.

verification.source: Local VM, source and model tests, run against an isolated copy; see accompanying project records.
verification.browser: Before publication: isolated browser tested summon pause, A/N input, resume and skip, singularity and a synthetic C4 Ghost duel.
verification.audioContextAndAssistiveClick: Simulated environment; physical devices and assistive technologies were not verified.

storage: Existing discovery records and legacy C4 records are preserved by supported compatibility paths. Browser storage may be unavailable and non-cooperative cross-tab operations have limitations.
